verdict.rationale: Heap documents several server-side APIs, including track, bulk track, identify, account properties and user deletion. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versioning, version identifiers, or a deprecation policy. Versioned APIs are a fair question for an analytics SaaS, so this is an applicable axis with no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
